playbooks.description: Opens the unified catalog root, switches from Components to Hooks, and changes its presentation mode. This protects the root workspace and its selector-backed primary catalog controls after the dashboard/components/adoptions routes were removed.
Opens the catalog, selects Hooks, enters the first hook asset, and proves its shared non-renderable workspace exposes Files and Details rather than a preview iframe.

Opens the BottomNav@1.2.0 preview harness (example=mobile-primary) at top level, focuses the first navigation item, presses Tab, and asserts focus advances to a later item that is still inside the nav element. Proves BottomNav items are keyboard-reachable in sequence rather than only pointer-operable.

Opens the DrawerShell@1.0.0 preview harness (example=full-open) at top level and proves the focus trap: after focusing the in-panel close button and pressing Tab, keyboard focus stays inside the role=dialog panel instead of leaking to the backdrop or document body. This is the exact failure class the DrawerShell pilot exposed that screenshot-diffs cannot catch. The paired calibration bas/calibration/drawershell-focus-trap-broken.json runs the same assertion against DrawerShell@0.1.0 (which has no useFocusTrap) and must fail.

Opens the Select@1.1.0 preview harness (example=selected, defaultValue=native) at top level, focuses the combobox, presses ArrowDown, and asserts the selected value advances from 'native' to 'compatible'. Proves the Select component honours keyboard option navigation, not merely that it renders a combobox.

Navigates to the seeded StatusBadge component editor at desktop width and proves the Preview Workspace is usable: all specimens become rendered, Appearance and Viewport each open an explanatory anchored control surface, a specimen can enter bounded comparison, and the active specimen exposes its temporary JSON props experiment. This fails when preview routing regresses, the compact controls are not wired, or gallery interaction is unavailable.

Opens the seeded StatusBadge editor at a narrow phone viewport and proves the preview workspace retains exactly its compact Appearance and Viewport entry points alongside the specimen gallery. This guards the responsive control density of PR-001, VP-001, and DV-001 without relying on a brittle screenshot-only assertion.
